module.purpose: Derives a shared rendezvous identifier from execution code and an optional canvas identifier so the server and widget can address the same exec result.
module.summary: This shared utility creates a deterministic, truncated SHA-256 key for rendezvous storage. It combines the canvas identity with executable code when a canvas identifier is truthy, otherwise hashing only the code, and returns the first 32 hexadecimal characters. The implementation relies on Web Crypto and TextEncoder APIs available in both the Cloudflare worker and browser runtimes.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable handoff of widget execution results to the server through a CanvasStore rendezvous object. Incorrect derivation can lose results or route them to the wrong canvas invocation.
functions: computeExecKey (~L16-21): Deterministically hashes execution code and optional canvas identity.
systemCapabilities: Coordinate widget and server result handoff

preconditions: code is provided as a string.
postconditions: Returns a Promise resolving to a string execution key.
The same code and canvas context produce the same execution key.
invariants: When canvasId is truthy, the key material includes the canvas identifier followed by a newline and the code.
When canvasId is absent or an empty string, the key material is the code alone.
edgeCases: A missing canvasId causes the code alone to be used as key material.
An empty-string canvasId is treated as absent because the optional identifier is selected by truthiness.
Different truthy canvas identifiers are included in the key material and can distinguish otherwise identical code.
